red_flags.summary: Export regulations limited ability to serve Chinese customers
red_flags.quote: The United States government has implemented export regulations for U.S. semiconductor technology sold or provided to customers in China, which have limited our ability to provide certain products and services to customers in China, over the past several years.
Cash provided by operating activities in fiscal 2025 was lower primarily due to higher payments for income taxes and inventory.
